Name: Rebekah's Tiny Farm Cave
Author: RebekahArt
Description:
Hi! 

I'm [b]Rebekah[/b], I just started doing mods for SV and I liked how they turned out so much that I wanted to share them.

This one here is the first one I made. I didn't like how empty the vanilla farm cave looked, but I didn't want to add new functions to it, also I wanted to keep it simple and small, just with a little bit more life to it. 

All the [b]tilesets [/b]use in this and all my mods are my own, I made them myself, so please [b]do not redistribute them or this mod[/b].



I don't know how to code so the mod it's probably not perfect, if you have any tips I'd be more than thankful, since I want to do more mods but I'm finding some issues that I don't know how to solve.



I'll be posting my other mods soon, and also will start posting news and content on my [b]site[/b], so if you are interested you can check it out here: [b]https://rebekahart.weebly.com/ [/b]

If you would like to [b]donate[/b], it would be more than welcome and I would deeply appreciate it, you can do so here https://ko-fi.com/rebekahart

Hope you like my mod, and thank you for downloading it.



Love, R.
